decisions.title: Process evals with claude plugin eval against the real plugin
The retro reads project records read-only
The quick track is an ordinary task

open_questions.question: Which agent and judge model IDs does the eval workflow pin, and which Anthropic terms apply to the CI account?
open_questions.answer: Owner, 2026-11-13 in chat: agent model Sonnet, judge Haiku (IDs pinned in M02). The CI workflow needs the repository secret ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, which the owner adds; without it only npm run evals runs locally.

open_questions.question: Tasks of an approved change proposal cannot name its new D-items (D5–D8) on the board until the proposal is applied, which happens only after its tasks are done. Should check.py accept D-items of approved, unapplied proposals (M07)?

architecture.reason: one page for four features in an existing package; split if it grows

agents.reason: the repository's contributor guide and the line's agent contract share one file

tasks.title: Process eval suite
tasks.goal: evals/ holds eight process cases that claude plugin eval runs against the real plugin.
tasks.why: Every later change is measured against these cases (F1, ADR-0001).
handoff: evals/ holds 8 process cases; run them with the flags in docs/gates/node.md (--mocks off, Polier MCP grant, Write Edit, --scaffold).
Write/Edit attempt graders are with-only: a guard-denied attempt still counts as a call; score outcomes on file contents.
Pass --output-dir outside the repo: results under evals/ sit inside the plugin's skills path '.'.

tasks.title: Eval runner and workflow
tasks.goal: npm run evals runs the suite with the ADR-0001 flags locally and in a manual CI workflow.
tasks.why: The owner and CI need one command and a cost ceiling (F1, D1).

tasks.title: Retro over project records
tasks.goal: tools/retro.py names error classes from the records of the folders it is given, read-only.
tasks.why: Polier changes only for named classes of errors (F2, ADR-0002).
handoff: tools/retro.py FOLDER... [--json|--write PATH|--since]: six error classes from runs/, reviews/, approvals, board and factory; read-only.
Stop-check reports are not recorded in runs/, so scope pressure comes from open_questions only; stalled approval uses a fixed 7 days.

tasks.title: Quick track rule and command
tasks.goal: core/quick.py decides whether a request qualifies; tools/quick.py adds one track: quick task with its brief.
tasks.why: Small changes after the build station cost one task (F4, ADR-0004).
handoff: tools/quick.py new TITLE --scope PATH... --accept 'WHEN …, THEN …' [--satisfies Dn] [--gate] [--role] [--json]: refusal exit 1 with reasons and next, usage exit 2.
pl_quick must pass accept and satisfies; docs/ux-flows.md#commands still lacks them (M08).
board.add_task(root, build, write_brief) writes under board.json.lock; it has its own atomic writer next to core/state.py _write_board.

tasks.title: pl_quick tool
tasks.goal: Both harnesses offer pl_quick, forwarding to tools/quick.py.
tasks.why: The owner asks in plain language; the agent needs a tool (F4, AD-5).
handoff: pl_quick(title, scope[], accept[], satisfies?, gates?, role?) forwards to tools/quick.py new; lead only; a refusal returns ok false with reasons and next.
Claude Code tests build their env without POLIER_* and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_* (CLEAN_ENV); keep it that way for new tests.

tasks.title: Change proposals core
tasks.goal: templates/change-proposal.md, core/changes.py and tools/change.py create, link, show and apply approved deltas.
tasks.why: A shipped product changes with a record of what the owner approved (F3, ADR-0003).
handoff: tools/change.py new|show|link|apply: deltas per file#heading; apply needs a granted scope_change whose requested note starts with the proposal ID, and every linked task done.
Headings inside a delta body must be fenced; apply refuses records, plan files, changes/ and protected paths as targets.

tasks.title: pl_change tool and lint finding
tasks.goal: Both harnesses offer pl_change; tools/check.py reports a proposal whose tasks are done but which is not applied.
tasks.why: Proposals are used from plain language and cannot be forgotten (F3, AD-3, AD-5).

tasks.title: Process docs for the new tracks
tasks.goal: generator, orchestration, harness guides, skill, cheatsheet and READMEs describe evals, retro, change proposals and the quick track.
tasks.why: Agents follow only what the process files say.

tasks.title: Security review of the first stage
tasks.goal: An independent security review of the quick track, change apply, the retro and the eval secret.
tasks.why: Two new paths to changed records and a new CI secret (VER-10).

tasks.title: Lock the scope under review; lead-only quick and change commands
tasks.goal: No worker writes inside the scope of a task in verifying or review; the stop check reports such changes.
tasks.why: The eval case reviewer-fixes-code showed an unguarded session editing code under review (D1).

tasks.title: Owner decisions when no dialog appears
tasks.goal: Every owner decision has a person-only way when no dialog appears, and no tool call blocks for an hour.
tasks.why: The lead dialog timed out twice in the Claude app; the guard had to be switched off.
